# Kettle Harness Instructions

## Git Rules

- Stay on your assigned branch — never checkout or push to main
- Your branch: `thread/kettle-gitignore/work`
- Commit frequently with clear, descriptive messages
- Do not amend commits that may have already been pushed

## Workspace

- Only modify files within the workspace directory

## Allowed Files

You may only modify files in these paths:
- **/*

## MCP Tools

A Kettle MCP server is available for tool access.

Use `mcp__kettle__Read` for structured repository file reads. Pass `file_path` and optional positive integers `offset` (1-based starting line) and `limit` (number of lines).
